findings.title: Native success ignores the reaped host exit status
findings.evidence: pure-results.json: nonzero host exit acceptance probe; returncode 17 produces controller exit0 and SCOPED_NATIVE_PASS after wait, both FD closes and fake positive ESRCH.
findings.impact: A host crash or abnormal exit after publishing the consuming proof is reported as a native scenario pass. OS closure and valid accounting do not establish successful host completion.
findings.requestedChange: After full closure, require owner['p'].returncode == 0 in the final passed predicate; preserve safe retirement for nonzero exits and report CLOSED_SCENARIO_FAILURE.

findings.title: Build attestation identifies a different source manifest digest
findings.evidence: hash-verification.json: current manifest bytes agree with source-freeze.json, manifest.json and compact receipt; build-attestation.json sourceManifestSHA256 differs.
findings.impact: The delivered build attestation cannot be checked against the delivered frozen source-manifest bytes, despite exact host and executable hash matches.
findings.requestedChange: Correct the attestation digest to the delivered frozen manifest and refresh its containing manifest hash; no source rebuild is indicated by this discrepancy alone.

limitations: Host scheduling/atomic publication branches inspected statically
